newsitem.title: USA: IOWA-S MINN FED CATTLE NOT WELL ESTABLISHED - USDA.
newsitem.headline: IOWA-S MINN FED CATTLE NOT WELL ESTABLISHED - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Wednesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, USDA said. Trade very slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings moderate.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Wednesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested.
